scope: minimum constraints for any future Gate4 replacement after 001E route closure

minimum_requirements.text: The target must not be recoverable by faithful pair-count, full-bundle, serialized-state, trace-only lookup, or equivalent non-mechanism decoders.
Baselines must receive fair access to every information surface available to the candidate, including state, observation, legal history, feedback, query outputs, and trace surfaces where relevant.
Query-capable and feedback baselines must be strong enough to match candidate affordances, budgets, timing, and access boundaries.
Positive-control leakage scanners must fail when leakage is injected into the same candidate-visible surfaces used by the candidate.
Replay must recompute candidate behavior from serialized state plus observation, and from any candidate-visible feedback/query history when those surfaces are part of the task.
Ablations must rerun episodes under real interventions rather than editing reports or returning static failure flags.

Reported result, baseline, ablation, contrast, leakage, and replay metrics must record callable producers, source artifacts, run IDs, seed/context/episode IDs, aggregation rules, and code path hashes.
Baselines must be independent callable implementations, not static score dictionaries or test-only pass verdicts.
A pass may claim only bounded offline mechanism-proxy evidence for the named test. It must not claim consciousness, selfhood, agency, autonomy, emotion, EGO readiness, or user benefit.
Any future Gate4 design must cite 001E as negative evidence and explain why the new task is not a 001D-derived repair.

blocking_conditions_for_future_design: candidate receives access denied to fair baselines
query-capable baseline is weaker than candidate affordances
positive-control leakage scan does not fail on injected leakage
replay does not recompute from serialized state plus observation
ablations do not rerun episodes under intervention
provenance lacks callable producers or code path hashes
